collection.title: BMW X2 2018 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW X2 2018 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Specific Push Button attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this BMW X2 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.

image.alt: BMW X2 2018 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
